einstellungen.text: Out of your whole apartment, you can save one piece of furniture.
Your space station is building the new dome out of your rooms. There's hardly space for furniture.
"I'm taking the closet doors. All of them."
Every year, Bo stuck stars on those closet doors.
Your mom needs her workbench. Without it, nobody fixes anything anymore.
And in the dome, nine families are waiting. Every one of them wants to save something too.
Then you look at the kitchen table. At the scratches you made when you were six.
You ate at this table every night. It still smells like soup.
All you say is: The table stays. For everyone.
The three of you push it along the ring. The legs scrape across the floor.
In the dome, you put up fabric panels. Thirty-one sleeping nooks around one table.
With the neighbors, you set the rules. One nook per person. Quiet after ten. The table belongs to everyone.
Bo crawls under the table. He draws his yellow room from memory.
Your mom puts her arm around you. Neither of you says a word.
Then you sign your release next to your mom's name. On the plan, your apartment turns gray.
